id.instruksi: Baca kejadiannya, lalu sentuh bagian tumbuhan yang bekerja.
id.t-serap: Tanah di pot disiram. Bagian mana yang menyerap airnya?
id.t-angkut: Air dari akar dibawa naik sampai ke daun. Lewat bagian mana?
id.t-makanan: Tumbuhan membuat makanannya sendiri dengan cahaya Matahari. Di bagian mana?
id.t-lebah: Lebah datang, lalu tumbuh buah dan biji. Bagian mana yang didatangi lebah?
id.t-angin: Angin kencang bertiup, tetapi pohon tidak roboh. Bagian mana yang mencengkeram tanah?
id.t-seledri: Seledri ditaruh di air berwarna merah. Besoknya daunnya kemerahan. Warnanya naik lewat mana?
id.t-gelap: Tanaman disimpan di lemari gelap seminggu. Bagian mana yang menguning karena tidak bisa membuat makanan?
id.t-biji: Bagian mana yang nanti berubah menjadi buah dan biji?
id.t-siramdaun: Tanaman layu hanya disemprot daunnya, tanahnya tetap kering. Bagian mana yang sebenarnya butuh air?
id.t-tegak: Bunga matahari tetap berdiri tegak menghadap cahaya. Bagian mana yang menopangnya?

en.instruksi: Read what happens, then touch the plant part that is doing the work.
en.t-serap: The soil in the pot is watered. Which part takes in the water?
en.t-angkut: Water from the roots travels up to the leaves. Through which part?
en.t-makanan: A plant makes its own food using sunlight. In which part?
en.t-lebah: Bees visit, then fruit and seeds grow. Which part do the bees visit?
en.t-angin: A strong wind blows, but the tree doesn't fall. Which part grips the soil?
en.t-seledri: Celery stands in red water. Next day its leaves are reddish. Which part did the colour travel up?
en.t-gelap: A plant is kept in a dark cupboard for a week. Which part turns yellow because it can't make food?
en.t-biji: Which part later turns into fruit and seeds?
en.t-siramdaun: A wilting plant only gets its leaves sprayed and the soil stays dry. Which part really needs the water?
en.t-tegak: A sunflower stands tall facing the light. Which part holds it up?
